Launch brokerer Tyvak, ?
Oneliner

Off-the-shelf commercial smartphone as the control system for the satellite and other technology demonstrations.
Description

Test the smartphone's capability as communication technology for nanosatellites and as hardware to manage pointing, taking images and software execution.

Several improvements over the previous mission, including a two-way radio to enable command of the satellite from the ground, solar arrays to enable it to be operational for up to a year, and a system for attitude control.
